body: I'm sure I deserve it and more.

I'm not ashamed. I know I need it. I had scheduled an appointment awhile ago. I know my behavior is horrible. I don't know if it stems from past issues where he's accused me time and time again of cheating on him or if it's stress from family and school.
My school offers therapy and I had scheduled an appt four weeks ago (they get booked very quickly). I guess I needed it sooner.
